sketch:
Observe: SVG horizontal track with a bob oscillating at
x(t) = Xₘ·cos(ωt+φ); student adjusts Xₘ, ω, φ sliders; x(t) waveform
drawn beside. Ticker drives the oscillation at a chosen visual pace
(simTime = animTime · scale). Experiment: 3 seeded (Xₘ, T, φ)
targets; student matches by aligning the live bob with a target
ghost. Evaluate: waveform hidden; only the bob and target ghost
shown; student tunes parameters until they overlap through a full
cycle. Wrinkle: T = 2π/ω and φ interpretation as "avance de phase".
